keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: Safe and self-evolving LLM agents
themes.summary: The papers examine how LLM agents can improve themselves through feedback, memory, harness evolution, skill acquisition, and recursive self-improvement while remaining safe. They build benchmarks, training recipes, and runtime safeguards to test or enforce safety under evolving capabilities, including hidden-rule learning, privacy, prompt injection, approval, monitoring, and failure recovery. They differ in whether they benchmark self-evolution, transfer evolved harnesses or memories to new agents, or provide defenses and verification mechanisms for safe agent behavior.

themes.name: Embodied robot learning, navigation, and 3D perception
themes.summary: The papers develop embodied methods that couple perception, world modeling, and control for manipulation, navigation, and 3D scene understanding. They range from video/action world models and imitation or dexterous-skill transfer to egocentric hand-scene reconstruction, LiDAR-guided token selection, occupancy forecasting, and Gaussian/VIO SLAM. Others target safety filtering and multi-robot or humanoid motion planning, differing mainly in whether they emphasize policy learning, world-model planning, 3D perception, or safe navigation.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow matching generative models
themes.summary: The papers apply diffusion and flow matching as generative priors across Bayesian estimation, anomaly detection, language modeling, motion and image generation, inverse problems, and sampling. They differ in using flow matching for posterior or conditional sampling, diffusion for detection/editing/benchmarking, and trainable SDE, flow-map, or distillation methods to improve efficiency, controllability, and generation order.

themes.name: Privacy, unlearning, and adversarial robustness
themes.summary: The papers study privacy, unlearning, and robustness across ML deployments: they remove sensitive influence from recommendation models and LLM knowledge, infer or leak user information from membership and tool-call traces, and design differential-privacy, federated-learning, and synthetic-data mechanisms with formal accounting. Others focus on robust learning and detection under contaminated samples, actuator degradation, distribution shift, and adversarial cyber conditions. They differ in whether the main goal is forgetting, disclosure quantification or limitation, or resilience to adversarial or corrupted inputs.

themes.name: Agentic scientific discovery and simulation calibration
themes.summary: The papers examine agentic and LLM-based systems for scientific discovery and simulation: an agentic calibration pipeline for cosmological simulations, agents that build and verify scientific evidence, and agents that specify automated PDE simulations or audit simulated robot benchmarks. They also introduce benchmarks for evidence deliberation and frontier materials R&D, plus methods for uncertainty and model discovery in scientific machine learning. They differ in whether the agent acts as an optimizer or specification builder for simulations, as a reasoning and verification assistant, or as the object of benchmark evaluation.

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical foundation models
themes.summary: The papers build and evaluate imaging and clinical models, often using pretrained or foundation-model representations for H&E/whole-slide pathology, retinal grading, MRI/PET/CT segmentation, and chest X-ray or ECG tasks. They differ in emphasis: lightweight deployment and calibrated decision support, multimodal and atlas-informed segmentation, multi-teacher distillation and routing, and auditing cross-site generalization, data reuse, and correlated failures.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference, pruning, and routing
themes.summary: The papers target efficient LLM inference by compressing context/KV cache, quantizing weights, pruning MoE experts or weights, routing/scheduling requests, and designing sparse, linear, or looped attention/memory architectures. They differ in whether they reduce stored state, remove parameters, dynamically select models or experts, or restructure computation, with some focusing on serving-system coordination and others on model-level sparsity or context transfer.

themes.name: Benchmarks and evaluation for LLMs and VLMs
themes.summary: The papers introduce and analyze benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation protocols for assessing large language models and vision-language models across spatial reasoning, compositionality, commonsense, fairness, bias, cultural alignment, video understanding, and review or judge behavior. They differ in modality and domain—such as UAV, underwater, panoramic video, robotic manipulation, and image composition—and in evaluation design, including controlled single-edit pairs, counterfactual augmentations, pre-registered protocols, simulated personas, and explicit unbiased baselines.

themes.name: RAG robustness and evaluation
themes.summary: The papers examine the robustness and evaluation of retrieval-augmented generation, introducing a matched-query protocol that jointly examines clean and poisoned responses to show what attack success rate hides, and demonstrating how incomplete relevance judgments distort abstention scoring in conversational RAG. They also test whether multiple mutually agreeing poisoned documents induce conformity bias in models, and audit when agentic assistants actually search beyond their static internal memory. They differ in whether the focus is defense measurement, benchmark label validity, susceptibility to knowledge poisoning, or real-world search decisions.

themes.name: RL post-training and inference-time alignment
themes.summary: These papers study RL post-training and inference-time alignment for language models and agents, covering asynchronous optimization, group-relative methods, training-inference mismatch from numerics or stale weights, reward/replay signals for long-horizon and reasoning tasks, and judge- or preference-based learning. They differ by intervention point: sampling and policy optimization, served-weight/numeric correction, reward and verification design, or evaluation/benchmarking, across settings such as code-as-policy robots, Freeciv agents, text-rich VLM reasoning, and preference learning.

themes.name: Mechanistic interpretability and activation steering
themes.summary: The papers use mechanistic interpretability and representation steering to inspect and control internal model behavior, with sparse autoencoders, head pruning, KV-cache patching, and readout analyses for localization and steering/task vectors or representation sampling for intervention. They differ by domain and intervention point, covering histopathology, LLMs, robotics, driving, retrieval, and genomics, and by whether they aim to understand mechanisms or actively steer behavior.

themes.name: Continual adaptation and capability retention
themes.summary: The papers examine how models can continually adapt while retaining protected or general behavior, using mechanisms such as held-out anchors and post-update certification, self-modifying networks, hypernetwork repair, residual policy merging, lifelong genetic programming, and fixed logit corrections. They differ in whether they certify updates before commitment, repair capabilities after fine-tuning, merge task-specific residuals, or analyze plasticity and task assumptions. Their settings span language models, robot policies, scheduling, and reinforcement learning.

highlights.authors: Pengfei Zhou, Yixing Ma, Zhengfeiyang Zhang et al.
highlights.theme: Embodied robot learning, navigation, and 3D perception

highlights.authors: Yijia Fan, Xilin He, Yilei Jiang et al.

highlights.key_result: CaPtain-4B, obtained by post-training Qwen3.5-4B with the CaPtain pipeline, raises held-out LIBERO success from 0% to 55.4% after SFT and to 73.8% after RL, and reaches 78.5% on LIBERO-PRO, surpassing several frontier-model agents.

news.summary: Google DeepMind's PlanAssist, built with Gemini, is being extended to 12 more English local planning authorities after pilots in Barnet, Camden and Dorset cut planning officer time on householder assessments by 58%, with over 70% of generated reports approved without edits. The tool validates documents, checks heritage and policy constraints, and drafts cited reports, moving into a 12-month beta with live applications across 15 councils total, with government plans for all English councils in 2027.

news.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
news.summary: Microsoft Research described its Industry Evaluation Data Generation Platform, which builds full-scale synthetic enterprise 'tenants' grounded in public sources such as O*NET data, job postings and SEC filings to evaluate Microsoft Copilot without using customer data. The platform combines synthetic environments, automated query generation pipelines and structured quality frameworks, with automated content-safety checks on all generated data.

news.title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
news.summary: Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute are using agentic AI at the Allen Telescope Array, where agents can steer the instrument and process data from a natural language request, with NVIDIA Holoscan's DAQIRI library pulling terabits per second of sensor data into GPU memory and the Nexus orchestrator handling 2.4 terabits per second on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs. The pipeline achieved a first real-time AI detection of a pulsar in the Crab Nebula, and the team is evaluating open models including NVIDIA Nemotron.

news.title: Build a Validated Kubernetes Runtime for NVIDIA Dynamo
news.summary: NVIDIA described how its AI Cluster Runtime (AICR) packages NVIDIA Dynamo and its Kubernetes runtime dependencies — GPU driver stacks, Dynamic Resource Allocation, gang scheduling, node health signals and Prometheus metrics — into validated recipes with pinned component versions. Dynamo 1.4.2 uses TCP for the request plane and ZMQ for KV-cache events, supporting both the native Dynamo Frontend router and the Gateway API Inference Extension/Endpoint Picker path, deployed through a five-step snapshot-to-validation flow.

news.title: Run AI Models for Edge Application Development with Just a Few Commands
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced TensorRT Edge-LLM, a lightweight C++ inference runtime for embedded development on the 64GB DGX Spark that also targets Jetson Thor, DRIVE AGX Thor and IGX Thor, with a trtedge CLI that downloads models and builds TensorRT engines. The tutorial runs Nemotron-3.5 Lightning with an approximately 21GB download, and DSpark speculative decoding with three draft tokens raises mean generation speed from 73.4 to 126.9 tokens per second on HumanEval prompts at 27.9GB peak memory.

news.title: Build Specialized Agents on a Stack You Control with NVIDIA NemoClaw
news.summary: NVIDIA announced NemoClaw open blueprints that combine a tuned agent harness, Nemotron models, NeMo optimization tools and the OpenShell secure runtime, currently supporting OpenClaw, Hermes Agent and LangChain Deep Agents. LangChain tuned its Deep Agents harness for Nemotron 3 Ultra, reporting near-frontier performance at approximately 10x lower cost per run, with the tuned model profile available on GitHub.

news.title: How to Check and Configure NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage for Your Platform
news.summary: NVIDIA released gds-diag, an open-source command-line utility in the Magnum IO GitHub repository that assesses GPUDirect Storage environments with subcommands for end-to-end checks, pre-installation validation, post-installation verification and container diagnostics, reporting FAIL, WARN, INFO and PASS statuses with mitigation plans. An optional agent skill adds natural-language orchestration, and the tool requires Linux with Python 3.8 or newer.

news.title: nemotron-halloween
news.summary: A Hugging Face post describes MonsterHouse, a Halloween interactive projection built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with Nemotron 3 ASR, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB with a LoRA personality adapter, Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D in Unreal Engine 5, plus Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, YOLO and ByteTrack for visitor description and tracking. It runs on a single workstation with an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q and an RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell.

news.title: Managing Amazon Bedrock costs end to end: A playbook for FinOps and platform teams
news.summary: AWS outlined a five-stage loop for managing Amazon Bedrock costs — attribute, observe, enforce, optimize, operate — split between FinOps and platform engineering teams. Amazon Bedrock automatically attributes inference costs to the calling IAM principal across all models, with the caller's ARN recorded in the line_item_iam_principal column of the AWS Cost and Usage Report 2.0.

news.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: AWS described Session endpoints in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime, which give each agent session an authenticated URL that forwards HTTP and WebSocket traffic to allowed ports (1–5 entries within 8000–12000 set via allowedPorts), letting developers preview a Vite web app live as a coding agent edits it. Requests carry SigV4 signatures or bearer tokens, and SDK clients can proxy through a local endpoint such as http://localhost:8088.

news.title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Worldwide Express, working with AWS and LTM, built a multi-agent Bedrock solution on Amazon EC2 with three specialized agents (Invoice Matching, Pricing Variance and others) to resolve LTL freight billing exceptions in its SpeedShip TMS. Six months after launch it reported a 75% reduction in active exceptions, a 4-week improvement in time-to-cash, $1M annual savings and a one-time $10M free cash flow infusion.

news.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
news.summary: AWS published a walkthrough for configuring the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex to route model inference through Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-West), using API-mode sign-in, a managed device policy, a named AWS profile and network restrictions. Access is governed by IAM, is billed per token with no seat licenses, and supports zero data retention.

themes.summary: 这些论文研究 LLM 智能体如何通过反馈、记忆、harness 进化、技能习得和递归自我改进来提升自身，同时保持安全。它们构建基准、训练配方和运行时防护措施，以测试或强制在能力进化下的安全性，包括隐藏规则学习、隐私、提示注入、批准、监控和故障恢复。它们的区别在于是否对自我进化进行基准测试、将进化的 harness 或记忆迁移到新智能体，或为安全的智能体行为提供防御和验证机制。

themes.name: 具身机器人学习、导航与 3D 感知
themes.summary: 这些论文开发具身方法，将感知、世界建模和控制结合起来，用于操作、导航和 3D 场景理解。它们涵盖视频/动作世界模型、模仿或灵巧技能迁移、第一人称手部-场景重建、LiDAR 引导的 token 选择、占用预测以及 Gaussian/VIO SLAM。其他工作针对安全过滤和多机器人或人形运动规划，主要区别在于强调策略学习、世界模型规划、3D 感知还是安全导航。

themes.name: 扩散与流匹配生成模型
themes.summary: 这些论文将扩散和流匹配作为生成先验应用于贝叶斯估计、异常检测、语言建模、运动和图像生成、逆问题以及采样。它们的不同之处在于使用流匹配进行后验或条件采样，使用扩散进行检测/编辑/基准测试，以及使用可训练的 SDE、流映射或蒸馏方法来提高效率、可控性和生成顺序。

themes.name: 隐私、遗忘与对抗鲁棒性
themes.summary: 这些论文研究机器学习部署中的隐私、遗忘和鲁棒性：它们从推荐模型和 LLM 知识中去除敏感影响，从成员资格和工具调用痕迹中推断或泄露用户信息，并设计具有正式核算的差分隐私、联邦学习和合成数据机制。其他论文关注在污染样本、执行器退化、分布偏移和对抗性网络条件下的鲁棒学习和检测。它们的区别在于主要目标是遗忘、披露量化或限制，还是对对抗性或损坏输入的韧性。

themes.name: 智能体科学发现与仿真校准
themes.summary: 这些论文研究用于科学发现和仿真的智能体及基于 LLM 的系统：用于宇宙学仿真的智能体校准流程、构建和验证科学证据的智能体，以及指定自动化 PDE 仿真或审计模拟机器人基准的智能体。它们还引入了证据审议和前沿材料研发的基准，以及科学机器学习中的不确定性和模型发现方法。它们的区别在于智能体是作为仿真的优化器或规范构建器、推理和验证助手，还是基准评估的对象。

themes.name: 医学影像与临床基础模型
themes.summary: 这些论文构建和评估影像与临床模型，通常使用预训练或基础模型表示进行 H&E/全切片病理、视网膜分级、MRI/PET/CT 分割以及胸部 X 光或 ECG 任务。它们的侧重点不同：轻量级部署和校准决策支持、多模态和图谱信息分割、多教师蒸馏和路由，以及审计跨站点泛化、数据重用和相关故障。

themes.name: 高效 LLM 推理、剪枝与路由
themes.summary: 这些论文旨在通过压缩上下文/KV 缓存、量化权重、剪枝 MoE 专家或权重、路由/调度请求，以及设计稀疏、线性或循环注意力/记忆架构来实现高效 LLM 推理。它们的不同之处在于是否减少存储状态、移除参数、动态选择模型或专家，或重组计算，有些侧重于服务系统协调，另一些侧重于模型级稀疏性或上下文迁移。

themes.name: LLM 与 VLM 的基准与评估
themes.summary: 这些论文引入并分析用于评估大型语言模型和视觉语言模型的基准、数据集和评估协议，涵盖空间推理、组合性、常识、公平性、偏见、文化对齐、视频理解以及评审或裁判行为。它们在模态和领域上有所不同——例如 UAV、水下、全景视频、机器人操作和图像合成——并且在评估设计上也有所不同，包括受控单编辑对、反事实增强、预注册协议、模拟角色和显式无偏基线。

themes.name: RAG 鲁棒性与评估
themes.summary: 这些论文研究检索增强生成的鲁棒性和评估，引入一种匹配查询协议，联合检查干净和中毒响应，以揭示攻击成功率所掩盖的问题，并展示不完整的相关性判断如何扭曲对话式 RAG 中的弃权评分。它们还测试多个相互一致的中毒文档是否会在模型中诱发从众偏差，并审计智能体助手何时真正搜索超出其静态内部记忆的内容。它们的区别在于关注点是防御测量、基准标签有效性、知识中毒易感性还是现实搜索决策。

themes.name: RL 后训练与推理时对齐
themes.summary: 这些论文研究语言模型和智能体的 RL 后训练与推理时对齐，涵盖异步优化、群体相对方法、由数值计算或陈旧权重引起的训练-推理失配、用于长时程和推理任务的奖励/重放信号，以及基于裁判或偏好的学习。它们的干预点不同：采样和策略优化、服务权重/数值校正、奖励和验证设计，或评估/基准测试，设置涵盖 code-as-policy 机器人、Freeciv 智能体、文本丰富 VLM 推理和偏好学习。

themes.name: 机制可解释性与激活引导
themes.summary: 这些论文使用机制可解释性和表示引导来检查和控制模型内部行为，采用稀疏自动编码器、头部剪枝、KV 缓存补丁和读出分析进行定位，并使用引导/任务向量或表示采样进行干预。它们因领域和干预点而异，涵盖组织病理学、LLM、机器人、驾驶、检索和基因组学，并根据目标是理解机制还是主动引导行为而有所不同。

themes.name: 持续适应与能力保持
themes.summary: 这些论文研究模型如何在保留受保护或通用行为的同时持续适应，使用留出锚点和更新后认证、自修改网络、超网络修复、残差策略合并、终身遗传编程和固定 logit 校正等机制。它们的区别在于是否在提交前认证更新、在微调后修复能力、合并任务特定残差，或分析可塑性和任务假设。其设置涵盖语言模型、机器人策略、调度和强化学习。

highlights.title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
highlights.authors: Pengfei Zhou, Yixing Ma, Zhengfeiyang Zhang et al.
highlights.theme: Embodied robot learning, navigation, and 3D perception
highlights.why: 引入了一个统一运行时，使慢速基础模型与快速策略之间能够异步协调，解决了具身智能体中的一个实际瓶颈。
highlights.key_result: REA 在 60 个 LIBERO-Pro 任务的 3,000 个测试回合上达到 95.9% 成功率，超过其自身策略池中的最佳单智能体基线（94.7%），并将控制步数减少 25%、控制时间减少 17%；在一项独立的 100 回合 RoboTwin 2.0 研究中，REA 使用 VLA 策略达到 84% 成功率，使用 VLA+code 达到 86%，而最强单 VLA 基线 MEDex 为 80%。
evidence: Evaluated on 3,000 test episodes across 60 LIBERO-Pro tasks, REA reaches 95.9% success and beats the best single-agent baseline in its own policy pool (94.7%) while reducing control steps by 25% and control time by 17%.
In a separate 100-episode RoboTwin 2.0 study, REA achieves 84% success with VLA policies and 86% with VLA+code, compared with 80% for the strongest single VLA baseline MEDex.

highlights.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
highlights.authors: Aman Tiwari, Akshay Kalkunte, Akintunde Oladipo et al.
highlights.why: 具备推理和工具使用能力的开放语音-语言模型，在音频基准上表现强劲，并支持语音优先的多模态智能体。
highlights.key_result: 在思考模式下，Apriel Voice 在 Big Bench Audio 上获得 98.90 分，在 Speech-BFCL 上获得 81.13 分，在 \tau-Voice 上任务成功率为 65.51%，平均延迟为 1.91 秒。它还获得了 51.27% 的英语 EVA 准确率和 74.13% 的 experience pass@1。
evidence: In thinking mode, Apriel Voice achieves a score of 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and a task success rate of 65.51% on \tau-Voice, with a mean latency of 1.91 seconds. It also achieves 51.27% English EVA accuracy and 74.13% experience pass@1.

highlights.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
highlights.authors: Byungwoo Jeon, Yoonwoo Jeong, Hyunseok Lee et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion and flow matching generative models
highlights.why: 引入连续潜在推理以桥接离散推理与图像生成，改善可控性和测试时扩展。
highlights.key_result: LARC 在 GenEval 上取得了最先进性能，比 BAGEL 高出 7%p，并展现出明显的测试时扩展行为，在并行和顺序测试时扩展策略下均优于基于 token 的生成。
evidence: Notably, LARC achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval with a 7%p gain over BAGEL and demonstrates clear test-time scaling behavior, outperforming token-based generation under both parallel and sequential test-time scaling strategies.

highlights.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
highlights.authors: Yijia Fan, Xilin He, Yilei Jiang et al.
highlights.theme: Embodied robot learning, navigation, and 3D perception
highlights.why: 提供了一个开放的后训练流程，将小型开放 VLM 转化为能力强的 code-as-policy 智能体，填补了低成本机器人控制的空白。
highlights.key_result: CaPtain-4B 通过使用 CaPtain 流程对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行后训练得到，将留出 LIBERO 成功率从 0% 提高到 SFT 后的 55.4%、RL 后的 73.8%，并在 LIBERO-PRO 上达到 78.5%，超越多个前沿模型智能体。
evidence: Starting from Qwen3.5-4B (0% zero-shot), CaPtain-4B reaches 55.4% held-out LIBERO success after SFT and 73.8% after RL. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 78.5%, surpassing several frontier-model agents, and its RL gains persist across three perturbation suites (+17.6 to +21.2 points).

Applying CaPtain to Qwen3.5-4B yields CaPtain-4B, which raises the held-out LIBERO success from 0% to 55.4% after SFT and to 73.8% after RL. On LIBERO-PRO, CaPtain-4B reaches 78.5%, above frontier-model agents such as K1 (77.2%), WAA (75.6%), and ASPIRE (71.7%).

highlights.title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
highlights.authors: Yu Li, Yufa Zhou, Tian Lan
highlights.why: 分析了失配的两个来源（数值计算和陈旧权重），并为每个来源确定了正确的补救方法，这对稳健的 on-policy RL 至关重要。
highlights.key_result: 在陈旧采样器下，DLC 将 on-policy 训练的 KL 散度保持在 Qwen3-0.6B 和 Qwen3-1.7B 上两次独立 on-policy 训练之间 KL 的两倍以内，其重新同步可防止逐 token 校正遗留的、以及在采样器前缀上测量的 KL 检测不到的崩溃。
evidence: Under a stale sampler, DLC keeps the KL divergence from on-policy training within twice the KL between two independent on-policy trainings on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B, and its resynchronization prevents collapses that the per-token corrections leave and that a KL measured on the sampler's prefixes does not detect.

highlights.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
highlights.authors: Shengguang Wu, Suning Huang, Cherie Ho et al.
highlights.why: 围绕冻结策略自动化 harness 设计，在无需微调的情况下获得大幅提升，这对智能体适应很重要。
highlights.key_result: RoboArchitect 围绕冻结策略自动化 harness 设计：在不更新任何模型权重的情况下，将未见场景上的平均成功率从 9.7% 提高到 43.3%（4.5 ），并将未见任务上的平均成功率从 12.7% 提高到 40.2%（3.2 ）。
evidence: Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5 ) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2 ), across multiple benchmarks and policies.

Across diverse benchmarks and policies, our auto-optimized harnesses raise the average success rate on unseen scenes from 9.7% to 43.3% (4.5 ), and on unseen tasks from 12.7% to 40.2% (3.2 ) ( fig:teaser).

highlights.title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
highlights.why: 引入一种匹配查询协议，揭示 ASR 隐藏了防御引入的失败，这对正确评估 RAG 中毒防御很重要。
highlights.key_result: 在 HotpotQA 上使用一个毒化段落（p=1）时，TrustRAG 适配器阻止了 20 个目标阳性答案，但引入了 20 个新答案，因此最终计数仍为 60/100。类似地，KeywordAgg 阻止了 15 个目标阳性答案并引入了 15 个。

On HotpotQA with one poison passage (p=1), the TrustRAG adapter prevents 20 target-positive answers but introduces 20 new, therefore, the final count is unchanged at 60/100. Similarly, KeywordAgg prevents 15 target-positive answers and introduces 15.

highlights.title: Better Retrievers, Worse Labels: How Incomplete Relevance Judgments Distort Abstention Evaluation in Conversational RAG
highlights.why: 表明不完整的相关性判断会扭曲弃权评分，使更强的检索器看起来更差，这对对话式 RAG 评估至关重要。
highlights.key_result: 随着 nDCG@10 从 .18 上升到 .59，该协议的精度从 .68 下降到 .10；检索器越强，仍包含答案的无金标准上下文占比越大（28% 到 72%）。
evidence: The protocol's precision falls from .68 to .10 as nDCG@10 rises from .18 to .59 ( ).
The stronger the retriever, the larger the share of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer (28% to 72%) and the lower the shortcut's precision (.68 to .10; .70 to .21 under the audit).

OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
Community safety report and new protections for teens
Speeding up planning decisions with AI
news.summary: Google DeepMind 的 PlanAssist 基于 Gemini 构建，在 Barnet、Camden 和 Dorset 的试点将规划官员用于住户评估的时间减少了 58%，超过 70% 的生成报告无需编辑即获批准后，正扩展到另外 12 个英国地方规划机构。该工具验证文件、检查遗产和政策约束并起草带引用的报告，进入为期 12 个月的 beta 测试阶段，在总共 15 个议会处理实际申请，政府计划在 2027 年推广到所有英国议会。

news.title: From synthetic enterprise data evaluations to real Microsoft Copilot AI confidence
news.summary: Microsoft Research 描述了其行业评估数据生成平台，该平台基于 O*NET 数据、招聘信息和 SEC 文件等公开来源构建全规模合成企业“租户”，以在不使用客户数据的情况下评估 Microsoft Copilot。该平台结合了合成环境、自动化查询生成流程和结构化质量框架，并对所有生成的数据进行自动化内容安全检查。

news.title: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals
news.summary: Breakthrough Listen 和 SETI Institute 正在 Allen Telescope Array 使用智能体 AI，智能体可以根据自然语言请求操控仪器和处理数据，NVIDIA Holoscan 的 DAQIRI 库将每秒太比特级的传感器数据拉入 GPU 内存，Nexus 编排器在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 上处理每秒 2.4 太比特的数据。该流程首次实现了对蟹状星云中脉冲星的实时 AI 探测，团队正在评估包括 NVIDIA Nemotron 在内的开放模型。

news.title: Build a Validated Kubernetes Runtime for NVIDIA Dynamo
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了其 AI Cluster Runtime（AICR）如何将 NVIDIA Dynamo 及其 Kubernetes 运行时依赖项——GPU 驱动程序栈、动态资源分配、gang scheduling、节点健康信号和 Prometheus 指标——打包成经过验证的配方，并固定组件版本。Dynamo 1.4.2 使用 TCP 作为请求平面，ZMQ 作为 KV 缓存事件，同时支持原生 Dynamo Frontend 路由器和 Gateway API Inference Extension/Endpoint Picker 路径，通过五步快照到验证流程进行部署。

news.title: Run AI Models for Edge Application Development with Just a Few Commands
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出了 TensorRT Edge-LLM，这是一个轻量级 C++ 推理运行时，用于 64GB DGX Spark 上的嵌入式开发，同时也面向 Jetson Thor、DRIVE AGX Thor 和 IGX Thor，并提供 trtedge CLI 来下载模型并构建 TensorRT 引擎。该教程使用大约 21GB 的下载运行 Nemotron-3.5 Lightning，而 DSpark 投机解码使用 three 个草稿令牌，在 HumanEval 提示上以 27.9GB 峰值内存将平均生成速度从 73.4 提升到 126.9 tokens per second。

news.title: Build Specialized Agents on a Stack You Control with NVIDIA NemoClaw
news.summary: NVIDIA 宣布推出 NemoClaw 开放蓝图，结合了经过调优的 agent harness、Nemotron 模型、NeMo 优化工具和 OpenShell 安全运行时，目前支持 OpenClaw、Hermes Agent 和 LangChain Deep Agents。LangChain 针对 Nemotron 3 Ultra 调优了其 Deep Agents harness，报告每次运行成本降低约 10 倍，性能接近前沿水平，调优后的模型配置文件在 GitHub 上提供。

news.title: How to Check and Configure NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage for Your Platform
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 gds-diag，这是一个位于 Magnum IO GitHub 仓库中的开源命令行实用工具，用于评估 GPUDirect Storage 环境，提供用于端到端检查、安装前验证、安装后验证和容器诊断的子命令，报告 FAIL、WARN、INFO 和 PASS 状态并附带缓解计划。一个可选的 agent skill 增加了自然语言编排功能，该工具要求 Linux 和 Python 3.8 或更高版本。

news.title: nemotron-halloween
news.summary: 一篇 Hugging Face 帖子描述了 MonsterHouse，这是一个万圣节互动投影，基于 NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent 构建，使用 Nemotron 3 ASR、带 LoRA 个性适配器的 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB、Magpie TTS Zeroshot 和 Unreal Engine 5 中的 Audio2Face-3D，以及用于访客描述和跟踪的 Nemotron 3 Nano Omni、YOLO 和 ByteTrack。它在一台配备 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 和 RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell 的单工作站上运行。

news.title: Managing Amazon Bedrock costs end to end: A playbook for FinOps and platform teams
news.summary: AWS 概述了一个用于管理 Amazon Bedrock 成本的五阶段循环——attribute、observe、enforce、optimize、operate——由 FinOps 和平台工程团队分工。Amazon Bedrock 会自动将推理成本归因于所有模型中的调用 IAM principal，调用者的 ARN 记录在 AWS Cost and Usage Report 2.0 的 line_item_iam_principal 列中。

news.title: Preview web apps live as your coding agent builds them with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: AWS 描述了 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime 中的 Session endpoints，它们为每个代理会话提供一个经过身份验证的 URL，将 HTTP 和 WebSocket 流量转发到允许的端口（通过 allowedPorts 设置在 8000–12000 范围内的 1–5 个条目），使开发人员可以在编码代理编辑 Vite Web 应用时实时预览。请求携带 SigV4 签名或 bearer tokens，SDK 客户端可以通过本地端点（如 http://localhost:8088）进行代理。

news.title: How Worldwide Express automated freight exceptions with Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Worldwide Express 与 AWS 和 LTM 合作，在 Amazon EC2 上构建了一个多智能体 Bedrock 解决方案，包含三个专用智能体（Invoice Matching、Pricing Variance 等），用于解决其 SpeedShip TMS 中的 LTL 货运计费异常。上线六个月后，其报告显示活跃异常减少 75%，资金回笼时间有 4-week 的改善，每年节省 $1M，并一次性注入 $10M 自由现金流。

news.title: Configure the ChatGPT desktop app with Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
news.summary: AWS 发布了一份指南，介绍如何配置 ChatGPT 桌面应用和 Codex，以在 AWS GovCloud（US-West）中通过 Amazon Bedrock 路由模型推理，使用 API 模式登录、受管设备策略、命名 AWS 配置文件和网络限制。访问由 IAM 管理，按 token 计费，无需席位许可证，并支持零数据保留。
